messages:
Eloise (Legal): Urgent: EscrowCorp M&A closing tomorrow noon. Legal needs an immediate preservation hold on account org_67890. There's a retention migration in flight and we see multiple objects scheduled for deletion in ~48h. Please pause deletions + provide export of delete audit logs. Need confirmation within 1 hour. Case #INC-2026-8421

Ram (Support): On it — can you paste example object IDs or bucket paths? Also which retention policy applied (default vs custom)?

Eloise (Legal): We believe default retention was 90d, but customer claimed a custom preserve_until flag had been set earlier. Example object path: /objects/org_67890/escrow/documents/txn-2025-11-09-abc123. GET /v1/objects/txn-2025-11-09-abc123 returned ttl: 172800 (48h) and no preserve_until in response.

Jay (Eng Oncall): If TTL is showing in API response, it's scheduled. Ram — can you run an audit query for deletes for org_67890 for the last 72h? Suggest: `audit.query("org:org_67890 AND action:delete")`

Ram (Support): Running now. Also trying internal admin: `admin-preserve --org org_67890 --path /objects/... --until 2026-12-31` — hitting 403: `authorization_error: admin_action_requires-enterprise-role`.

Kyle (Ops): I can run admin-preserve from ops. If there are many objects we'll set an org-level preserve flag. Provide exact paths or I'll apply org_preserve_until.

Mariana (CS): I'll export object ids from the customer's migration logs and DM the CSV to Ram & Kyle. They mentioned a migration last week — preserve flag may not have been carried over.

Eloise (Legal): Also need audit logs showing any delete API calls accepted in last 24h, plus KMS usage for those objects. KMS key: kms://projects/prod/locations/global/keyRings/escrow/cryptoKeys/escrow-key-3 (HSM).

Ram (Support): Audit query shows 3 delete events in last 24h for org_67890 from svc-migration@redwood: two `delete_scheduled` and one `delete_executed`. txn-2025-11-09-abc123 has `delete_executed` at 2026-03-16T04:12Z. I'm pulling details now.

Jay (Eng Oncall): That indicates the migration job honored TTL. We need to check tombstone retention and whether the object data is still recoverable. If KMS key was rotated or access blocked, we'll need HSM team to help.

Kyle (Ops): I'll apply org_preserve flag now: `PATCH /internal/orgs/org_67890 { "preserve_until": "2026-12-31T23:59:59Z" }`. Posting when complete.

RetentionBot: hold_applied org=org_67890 preserve_until=2026-12-31T23:59:59Z actor=ops-kyle

Ram (Support): Confirmed org-level preserve set — this prevents future scheduled deletions. For already-deleted objects we follow recovery runbook: Eng to check tombstones/storage, Ops to coordinate KMS, Legal to approve export. I'm opening internal ticket INT-RETAIN-558.

Jay (Eng Oncall): Rehydrate plan: 1) Locate tombstone index: `GET /internal/tombstones?org=org_67890&since=2026-03-01` 2) If object present in cold storage, run restore: `restore_object --id txn-2025-11-09-abc123 --target org_67890` 3) If KMS access missing, request HSM team for unwrap token. ETA 2-4h.

Eloise (Legal): Legal approves restore and export. Preserve audit logs and provide chain-of-custody. No further deletions must happen while we handle handoff. cc @CFO

Mariana (CS): Uploaded CSV with 84 object ids to the DM. Ram & Kyle have it.

Ram (Support): Action items: 1) Pull full audit.log for delete events (saved to /incidents/INC-2026-8421/audit.log). 2) Kick rehydrate with Eng (Jay). 3) Coordinate KMS unfreeze with Ops (Kyle). 4) Deliver chain-of-custody doc to Legal.

Kyle (Ops): Noted. HSM team contact pinged — they warned if key was destroyed we can't recover. HSM TL says will respond in ~30m.

Jay (Eng Oncall): Starting restore for txn-2025-11-09-abc123. Logs: `restore_job START id=txn-2025-11-09-abc123 job=restore-INT-558`. Will report failures due to KMS immediately.

RetentionBot: restore_job update job=restore-INT-558 status=IN_PROGRESS id=txn-2025-11-09-abc123

Ram (Support): Note — migration job mj-2026-03-15-07 used flag `--force-ttl`. That likely overridden preserve metadata during copy. Adding to postmortem.

Kyle (Ops): HSM team: key intact, not destroyed. Granting temporary principal for restore. ETA 25m.

Jay (Eng Oncall): Restore succeeded for txn-2025-11-09-abc123. `restore_job COMPLETE id=txn-2025-11-09-abc123`. Rehydrated to /objects/org_67890/escrow/recovered/txn-2025-11-09-abc123.

Eloise (Legal): Thanks. Please confirm org-wide deletion pause and send written chain-of-custody + audit.log copy. Also we require a short postmortem explaining why preserve flag was lost during migration.

Ram (Support): Will deliver docs to legal inbox and publish postmortem. INT-RETAIN-558 updated with timeline and migration job details.

Mariana (CS): Scheduling customer call now to update EscrowCorp.

RetentionBot: case_closed INT-RETAIN-558 status=monitoring notes=\"org preserve active; recovered 1/84 objects; recovery plan for rest queued\"
